next_step: Use the frozen diagnostic release to formulate production retrieval policy without using post-hoc human reason codes as production inputs.
purpose: Freeze reproducible candidate-level diagnostics and by-work descriptive error/ambiguity analysis for the audited OpenAlex marginal retrieval universe.

semantics.alias_expansion_mechanism: Exploratory/deployable comparison feature derived with NFKC + casefold + whitespace collapse. This does not redefine frozen retrieval normalization.
semantics.multi_evidence_aggregation: No arbitrary representative query/alias/evidence row is selected. Counts, sorted unique sets, min/max and any-style aggregations are deterministic.
semantics.not_confirmed_valid: Convenience aggregate equal to INVALID + UNCERTAIN; not an error or false-positive label.
semantics.scope: Descriptive of the frozen audited 65-work / 661-candidate universe; no inferential or significance claim about the wider literary work population.
semantics.supplementary_registry_use: Alias registry v4 is used only for features absent from the candidate artifact, principally cross-project-work normalized title collision.
semantics.uncertain: UNCERTAIN remains distinct from INVALID throughout.
